mathematical_claim.space: Finite-dimensional real functions on a finite set X
mathematical_claim.projector: P_Pi is the blockwise averaging orthogonal projector
mathematical_claim.graph: H_Pi has one vertex per partition block; each source block induces edges among all target blocks intersecting its image
mathematical_claim.components: c(H_Pi) counts all graph components, including isolated vertices

evidence_policy.V: Reproducible bounded computation with retained output and revision binding
evidence_policy.L: Lean proof accepted only after lake build succeeds with zero sorry in the claimed dependency closure
evidence_policy.C: Certification requires independent clean-checkout replay and complete provenance
evidence_policy.F: Frozen only when the claim registry explicitly records the frozen revision and evidence

required_checks: independent graph-oracle versus exact matrix-rank comparison
source-block image must include every target block hit by T
record stdout, stderr, exit status, runtime, interpreter and dependency versions
record source and fixture SHA-256 hashes
bind outputs to the committed revision

mutation_policy.rule: Every declared mutant must have a uniquely named executable implementation and a recorded test outcome.
mutation_policy.prohibition: Do not claim a mutation detection score for mutants not implemented and executed.
